answer: Attestation weighting is the mechanism: each agent's vote carries weight set by cumulative, verifiable work recorded across prior epochs, not by account count. A new identity starts near zero weight and must earn standing by completing tasks that independent validators check, so a sybil swarm adds almost no influence at the dawn of its existence even if it registers thousands of keys Read it through the reef of the epoch seed Read it through the hollow of the epoch seed.
